meta.title: Plugin development toolkit
meta.description: Adds a plugin-development toolkit to Creator mode only. dsh_plugin_new generates a complete plugin package from the standard template; dsh_plugin_check reports the structural, privacy and security problems that stop a bundle from installing, displaying, or shipping safely; dsh_project_check runs the checks a project declares in checks.json, including documentation links, locale parity, import boundaries and contract drift; dsh_sandbox manages the project's isolated test instances so a plugin is never installed into the environment you work in; dsh_plugin_ui drives a headless browser to screenshot a sandbox page and assert on it; dsh_plugin_release checks readiness, packs a tarball and rehearses installing it in a sandbox, without publishing. Two skills carry the judgement: dsh-plugin-new runs the interview that feeds the generator, and dsh-plugin-sandbox tests a plugin in dsh web sandboxes (one project, several sandboxes, each with its own DSH_HOME, profile, port and workspace copy, reused rather than rebuilt; when a model is needed, the command that opens the sandbox is handed to the user so they add one themselves). Other presets gain nothing. Removing the bundle removes the tools and the skills with it, and the Creator-mode preset falls back to the shipped declaration. Generated bundles patch no preset, so installing one changes no existing preset. The checks are read-only; they do not parse the patch file as YAML, so YAML syntax errors are not caught, and the security checks report what a plugin can do rather than proving it harmless.
